title: Stellaris
shortDescription: Explore a galaxy full of wonders in this sci-fi grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studios. Interact with diverse alien races, discover strange new worlds with unexpected events and expand the reach of your empire. Each new adventure holds almost limitless possibilities.
zhShortDescription: Paradox 太空 4X 策略巨作——探索银河、建立帝国。
description: Get ready to explore, discover and interact with a multitude of species as you journey among the stars. Forge a galactic empire by sending out science ships to survey and explore, while construction ships build stations around newly discovered planets. Discover buried treasures and galactic wonders as you spin a direction for your society, creating limitations and evolutions for your explorers. Alliances will form and wars will be declared. Like all our Grand Strategy games, the adventure evolves with time. Because free updates are a part of any active Paradox game, you can continue to grow and expand your empire with new technologies and capabilities. What will you find beyond the stars? topReviews.review:
I used to love this game and have spent countless nights where I should have been studying, ruling the star systems with friends. However I am so tired of taking a break, coming back and having to relearn the game because they rework how the game runs and functions every month or so. Very few times have these changes actually improved the game, many break it. 

I understand it's paradox, but the DLC are insane, I have most of them and can that most of them should have been built into the main game for free. 

Last but not least.. The User data collection and selling of such data to third parti…
topReviews.zh_review: 我曾经爱这款游戏，度过了无数本该学习却跟朋友统治星系的夜晚。但我厌倦了每次休息回来都得重新学游戏——大概每个月就重做一次机制。很少改动真的改进了游戏。DLC太疯狂了，大部分应该免费整合进本体。用户数据收集和卖给第三方实在不齿。

topReviews.review:
The game is currently rated very positive for all time reviews, and mixed for recent reviews. Let me explain what's happening.

Game good. Game get update. Update causes loads of lag and very bug-ridden. Fanbase justifiably upset. Mixed reviews.

That being said, they have been working on addressing these issues since and the game runs better now. Stellaris has recently hit its 10-year anniversary and with this game getting constant free updates and new content since I think that while I agree the production team isn't without criticism the game is still really, really high quality.

topReviews.zh_review: 游戏目前全部评价非常好评，近期褒贬不一。游戏好→更新→造成大量卡顿和bug→粉丝合理不满→褒贬不一。不过他们一直在解决问题。群星刚过10周年，有持续免费更新。虽然制作组并非无可批评，但游戏质量仍然非常高。

topReviews.review: Like all paradox games, this is a scam meant to sell you DLC. The base game is a hollow shell. I paid for 1 month subscription to all the DLC and I can tell you that none of it is worth your cold hard cash. They sell you almost nothing in each DLC. It only looks like a lot of content spread out over 10 years of bloated development. They still demand retail prices for new DLC and season passes. The next DLC they promise ships that function like planets. Sounds cool but not worth paying money for it. If Paradox was a good company, they would have stopped developing this game and made Stellaris 2…
topReviews.zh_review: 像所有P社游戏一样，这是卖DLC的骗局。本体是空心壳。付了1个月全DLC订阅，可以告诉你没有一个值得你的钱。每个DLC几乎什么都没卖。只是10年臃肿开发中看起来内容很多。

topReviews.review:
我没能等到人类驶向深空，但群星让我提前赴了这场约。

在我眼里，银河从不是用来征服的，是用来填补遗憾的。探索、飞升、天灾、外交——每一局都像在另一条时间线上，亲手为文明点亮一片星海。生得太早，触不到真正的星辰。

但至少在这里，我决定过它们如何闪耀。

群星是本人入坑p社的第一款游戏（虽然现在玩钢丝多），可以说和文明6一样是我的大战略启蒙作，不可否认是一款十分优秀的游戏。
只是p社的逆天更新毁了这游戏，每次大版本都好像在玩全新的游戏一样，重新学习成本很高，然后这样也就算了，你们为什么要每次和更新都把游戏的数值向更狗屎的方向推动？？？
我喜欢这款游戏，所以我决定给它一个差评，希望p社能在以后不要再端上来像是4.3这种傻逼更新了，还有不要每个大版本大改玩法了!

whyPlay: Stellaris is the game where you start as a single planet and end as a galaxy-spanning empire that may or may not have accidentally become the crisis. The emergent storytelling is unmatched — your species might uplift primitives, fight interdimensional invaders, or become synth-ascended robots. Paradox's DLC model is aggressive, but the base game plus a few key expansions is one of the richest strategy experiences available.
whyPlayZh: 《群星》是一款你从单一星球开始，最终成为横跨银河帝国——可能还不小心变成了天灾——的游戏。涌现叙事无与伦比——你的物种可能提升原始文明、对抗跨维度入侵者、或成为合成飞升机器人。P 社 DLC 策略激进，但本体加几个关键扩展就能提供最丰富的策略体验之一。
